idea-plugin.name: Pubspec Pilot for Flutter
idea-plugin.description:
Lightweight, fast, and non-intrusive assistant for Flutter & Dart pubspec.yaml files by NyK.

Features:
  • Outdated Package Detection: Highlights outdated dependencies in pubspec.yaml with inline version hints and one-click Quick Fix updates.
  • Hybrid Package Auto-Completion (Online & Offline): Search and autocomplete packages directly from pub.dev with strict prefix matching, and automatically fallback to system local Pub Cache when offline.
  • Automatic flutter pub get: Automatically syncs packages in the background after inserting or updating a dependency, with graceful automatic fallback to --offline if internet is unreachable.
  • Zero Dart IntelliSense Interference: Operates strictly on pubspec.yaml so it never slows down or blocks Dart code completion.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.0
  • Initial release of Pubspec Pilot for Flutter.
  • Real-time outdated dependency detection with one-click Quick Fixes and interactive Inlay Hints.
  • Hybrid smart auto-completion (online from pub.dev with strict prefix filtering, and automatic offline fallback to system Pub Cache).
  • Automatic background flutter pub get with graceful retry via --offline when internet is disconnected.
